questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your second semester. *

questions.answer:
• ECON 2513 Global Economic History I, - Loved this as an Econ student and history passionate. 
• FILM 1006 Hollywood Film, - Because it's easy. 
• PHIL 2053 AI and Human Life: Ethics, Politics, Subjectivity, - Not so much. Didn't like the structure and wasn't used to taking philosophy courses made it harder
• POLIS 3003 Cyber-Politics. Politics & the Internet Revolution, - because it's interesting
